notes: The award is the Cal-GETC pattern itself, so its area course lists are recorded as blocks; ge_pattern is left null because no separate GE pattern is named for this award.
No total units are printed for the certificate as a whole; total_units is null.

Area-level unit statements are shared across sub-area blocks and are not recorded in those blocks' stated fields: Area 1 (1A, 1B, 1C) 'Nine semester units (or 12-15 quarter units)', Area 3 (3A, 3B) 'Six semester units (or 8-10 quarter units)', Area 5 'Seven to nine semester units (or 9-12 quarter units)'. Area 2 'At least three semester units' and Area 4 'At least six semester units' are recorded as stated minimums.
Area 4 also requires the two courses to be from different disciplines/subjects; Area 5 requires one course from 5A and one from 5B with one including a lab (Area 5C).

The catalog text is cut off mid-row in Area 5A (at PHYS A280). Area 5B, Area 5C, Area 6: Ethnic Studies, American Institutions Requirement and Language Other than English (UC only) are named in the page's tabs but their lists are not in the text, so no blocks are recorded for them.
Alternatives ('or' rows and honors twins) carry no units in the text; their units are left null.
Closed-list codes written without a space (ENGLC1001, MATHA180, MATHA185, MATHA280, MATHA285, ARTHC1200, ARTHC1200H) were matched to the catalog's spaced codes.
In Area 5A, a trailing '1' after many titles appears to be a footnote marker (probably lab designation), not units.
Several courses (e.g., CMST A155, GNDR A187, HIST A101, HIST A161) appear in both Area 3B and Area 4 and are listed in both blocks.
Footnote text: courses used to meet Cal-GETC must be at least three semester units; ESL A192 is printed at 4.5 units.

Part 2: The award is the Cal-GETC certification itself; the GE areas are recorded as blocks. The page prints no total units for the certificate, so total_units is null; ge_pattern left null since this is the pattern itself, not a degree naming one.

Part 2: Area totals ('Nine semester units', 'At least three semester units', 'Six semester units', 'At least six semester units', 'Seven to nine semester units') apply to whole areas spanning several blocks or are minimums; block stated left null.
Part 2: Area 4 requires two courses from different disciplines; Area 5 requires one course from 5A and one from 5B, one including a lab (Area 5C).

Part 2: Area 5A prints lecture+lab pairs (ASTR A100 & A100L or A100M; ASTR A100H & A100M or A100L; GEOG A180/A180H & A180L; GEOL A105 & A105L or A105M; GEOL A105H & A105M or A105L; GEOL A185 & A185L; MRSC A185 & A185L; PHYS A110 & A111) at 4 units for the pair; the lab courses are recorded once each with 1 unit, the lecture recorded separately.
Part 2: Text is cut off mid-row at PHYS A280 in Area 5A; its units are not printed. Area 5B, Area 6, American Institutions and Language Other than English tabs are not in the text.
Part 2: PUBH A203, PHYS A185 and PHYS A280 match closed-list codes PUBHA203, PHYSA185, PHYSA280 (spacing differs).

Part 2: Catalog codes in this part's region not on the closed list and not listed here per part instructions: HIST A198, PSCI A200 (Area 4); GEOG A130, PHYS A112, PHYS A125, PHYS A135 (Area 5A). They should be recorded as catalog additions.
Part 2: No program outcomes or careers are printed.
